articles.summary: NEW YORK – April 7, 2025 – Today, Lazard announced the launch of its first three actively managed ETFs in the United States, offering more investors access to compelling, differentiated strategies from Lazard’s specialized investment teams. Each ETF investment strategy is backed by decades of experience, deep independent research and on-the-ground expertise, offering unique opportunities for growth and diversification.
articles.title: Lazard Asset Management Launches Its First Three Active ETFs in the U.S.
